entry.name: Archeops-H4
entry.flavor: It needs a running start to take off. If Archeops wants to fly, it first needs to run nearly 25 mph, building speed over a course of about 2.5 miles.
entry.flavorEs: Si bien era capaz de volar, parece ser que se le daba mucho mejor cazar presas en tierra firme que en el aire.
entry.flavorZh: 虽然也会飞行， 但是似乎更擅长在 地面上捕捉猎物。

abilities.textEn: While this Pokemon has 1/2 or less of its max HP, its Attack and Sp. Atk are halved.
abilities.textEs: Se debilita tanto cuando sus PS se ven reducidos a la mitad que su Ataque y su Ataque Especial bajan.
abilities.detail: While this Pokemon has 1/2 or less of its maximum HP, its Attack and Special Attack are halved.
abilities.detailEs: El Ataque y el Ataque Especial de este Pokémon se reducen a la mitad cuando tiene la mitad de sus PS o menos.
abilities.detailZh: 当此宝可梦的HP为一半或以下时，其攻击和特攻减半。
abilities.detailPt: O Ataque e o Ataque Especial deste Pokémon são reduzidos pela metade quando ele tem metade do seu HP ou menos.
